🚜 BUYERS ARE ALREADY BIDDING 🚜

Our December Equipment & Vehicle Auction is still 12 days out, and pre-bidding is already busy. The 23 lots online so far have drawn more than 450 bids and 170 watchers:

• John Deere 950 diesel tractor (inoperable): 120 bids
• 2020 Better Built 14 ft tandem trailer: 71 bids
• Kubota L3450 4x4 with loader: 65 bids
• 1973 Massey Ferguson 255 diesel: 64 bids
• Ford 4600 cab tractor with blade: 54 bids

That's the kind of attention your equipment gets with Matthews, and we still have room in the sale.

WHAT WE'RE TAKING
• Tractors of every size, vintage to modern
• Loaders, skid steers and construction equipment
• Trucks, cars and other vehicles
• Trailers, hay and farm implements
• Shop tools and equipment

One piece or a whole barn full, running or not, we want to hear from you. Free consultation, no fees or commitments to talk it through.

Live & online Equipment & Vehicle Auction: Thursday, December 3. To consign, call or text Daniel at (276) 266-1265. Drop-offs Monday–Thursday at 299 E Virginia St, Galax, VA.

Details at MatthewsAuctioneers.com
